system.description: Starting at 2nd level, through discipline, creativity, and battlefield instinct, you develop unique Shinobi Katas that shape the way you fight. You learn one Katas of your choice. Your Kata options are detailed at the end of this Class. You gain more as you grow in level as detailed in the Weapon Specialist class table. If a Kata requires a saving throw, you use your Taijutsu save DC unless otherwise specified.
